rules.rule: Frozen event constraints, precise original task ownership and exclusive date boundaries remain separate from actual facts and responsibility windows.
rules.source: 2026-11-14 authorized Acceptance regression; approved v27 event preparation rules; docs/engineering/framework-event-target-semantics.md.
rules.initialization: No migration or persisted plan rewrite. Original forward plan and actual evidence retained. Explicit event keys use then-frozen milestones/downstream preparation; unrelated events are not exempted. Calculation version invalidates old projections. Legacy task identity uses only primary evidence.
rules.dateAndPermission: Date-exclusive midnight retained; real next-midnight completion is late. Missing upper bound never sufficient. No actual time, new SLA, permissions or current company standard inferred. Completion history uses original effective version and inherited source policy.
rules.expectation: No immediate creation-time budget overdue; genuinely missed handover remains late. Cutting does not acquire sewing facts. Date-only approval shows correct Beijing day and no spurious1ms gap. Original role scopes, pagination, historical facts and88-order SQL threshold retained.
